put_wall.definition: Strike with maximum put OI; not guaranteed support/resistance

dealer_gex_estimate.diagnostic_reason: Complete positive-OI coverage; production uses documented expiry underlying prices

methodology.label: Estimated signed dealer GEX; not observable dealer positioning
methodology.dealer_position_assumption: Dealer short calls (negative gamma), dealer long puts (positive gamma)
methodology.gamma_model: Standard Black-Scholes gamma with r=0 and q=0
methodology.reference_price_input: Each option expiry underlying_price used by Deribit for IV calculations
methodology.open_interest_units: Deribit option open_interest is underlying BTC; contract_size is not multiplied again
methodology.gex_units: USD per 1% move in the expiry-specific underlying = gamma * OI_BTC * underlying_price^2 * 0.01
methodology.repriced_flip_method: Parallel-shift each expiry underlying with spot over 50%-150% on 201 points; hold contract IV fixed; interpolate sign changes
methodology.cumulative_strike_flip_method: Sort current signed GEX by strike, cumulate low-to-high, and interpolate cumulative zero crossings
methodology.regime_rule: Sign of aggregate estimated dealer GEX at current snapshot
methodology.not_retailinterest: Independent model; RetailInterest is not queried by the collector

assumptions.open_interest_unit: BTC base currency as reported by Deribit

dealer_gex_estimate.gex_input_method: Two concurrent Deribit public/get_book_summary_by_currency calls (BTC and USDC) plus public/get_index_price

model_e_retailinterest_public_behavior_r.evidence: Calls positive, puts negative, single spot input, and 80%-125% strike filter reproduce the public API; contradicts its written dealer-sign methodology

gamma_reconciliation.deribit_gamma_precision_note: Ticker gamma is rounded to five decimal places; relative errors are unstable near zero

zero_gamma_flip_cumulative_strike.definition: Low-to-high cumulative current signed GEX by strike
